# CNN Academy

> > CNN Academy is a global journalism training institution offering professional development workshops, master's degree programs, and multimedia storytelling education across multiple international locations.

Founded by CNN and inspired by Ted Turner's vision, CNN Academy operates training centers in Atlanta, Abu Dhabi, and partnerships with institutions in Dublin, Hong Kong, and Kuala Lumpur. The academy focuses on digital journalism, mobile reporting, AI-enhanced storytelling, and newsroom simulation exercises for aspiring and professional journalists worldwide.
